subject: Commit amendment: Reserved pool upshift and hardware regrade (A100 → H100/L40S) — efficiency case
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Olivia James <olivia@fintechx.com>, procurement@fintechx.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal follow-up — reserved pool upshift + hw regrade options

Hi Olivia / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — appreciate the clarity on FintechX's Q2 throughput targets. Per our chat, I'm sending an initial sketch for the renewal amendment that covers: a) adding 120 GPUs to your reserved pool, b) option to regrade 60 existing A100 units to H100 or L40S, and c) a 12-month throughput guarantee clause tied to SLO credits.

Quick context: given your latency-sensitive fraud model and daytime peak patterns, H100 provides better peak token/s sustained burst performance, while L40S offers comparable steady-state throughput at lower $/token when quantized. I attached a short perf delta file that shows measured token/sec and cost-per-token across the three SKUs on your workload baseline.

Ask: could you confirm procurement's preferred approach (single-sku swap to H100, hybrid H100+L40S, or keep A100) and whether you need a formal bill-of-materials for internal approvers? If you prefer, we can turn this into an amendment we send to your legal and procurement teams for signature.

Attachments: fintechx_dedicated_quote_Q2.pdf, perf_delta_A100_H100_L40S.xlsx

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0183

From: Olivia James <olivia@fintechx.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-26T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal follow-up — reserved pool upshift + hw regrade options

Camila,

Thanks — quick clarifying questions from procurement and infra:
- We need a concrete cost-per-1M-tokens comparison (A100 vs H100 vs L40S) including the reserved discount and amortized reserved commit. Can you provide that on the same baseline as last quarter (avg seq len 256, 60% cache hit)?
- For the throughput guarantee: what form does the SLO credit take, and how does it apply across mixed hardware pools?
- What is the expected migration window and rollback plan if model regressions show up after SKU swap?

If you can include a short runbook and a single-page amendment we can share with finance/legal, that will speed things up.

Olivia
Head of ML Ops, FintechX
olivia@fintechx.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Olivia James <olivia@fintechx.com>, procurement@fintechx.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-29T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal follow-up — reserved pool upshift + hw regrade options

Olivia — thanks for the specific asks, summarized answers below and attached the short one-page amendment draft and the XLS perf sheet with the cost-per-1M-token rows you requested.

1) Cost-per-1M-tokens (baseline: seq=256, cache hit=60%, mixed batching profile):
   - A100 (current): $28.4 per 1M tokens (after reserved discount)
   - H100 (regrade): $20.1 per 1M tokens — ~29% savings on token cost for burst-heavy ranges
   - L40S (quantized): $16.9 per 1M tokens — ~41% savings, best for steady throughput with 8-bit quantization
   Notes: XLS shows assumptions and sensitivity to cache hit and batch size; H100 leads in latency and tail p99 under load, L40S wins on unit economics when models tolerate quantization.

2) Throughput guarantee / SLO credits:
   - Proposal: 99.5% token availability at agreed throughput per day. Missed SLOs trigger a credit equal to X% of monthly committed fees prorated (see amendment). For mixed pools we compute availability by weighted capacity equivalent (H100 eq tokens/sec + L40S eq tokens/sec normalized to A100 baseline).

3) Migration and rollback:
   - Migration window: staged swap over 48–72 hours with canary lane (10% traffic) → 50% → 100%.
   - Rollback: instant traffic diversion to A100 pool and archived model snapshot + KV cache warm-start plan. Documented in attached runbook (see amendment).

I added priyom to validate the perf numbers and Ben to confirm commercial terms we can offer for a 12-month commit amendment. If this looks good I'll prepare a final amendment and a DocuSign link.

Attachments: perf_delta_A100_H100_L40S.xlsx, amendment_draft.docx

Best,
Camila

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-02T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: internal: validate FintechX perf numbers and commercial levers

Internal notes / quick answers for pricing team —
- Perf sheet verified against FintechX production traces they shared (thanks Camila). H100 shows ~1.4–1.6x token throughput per GPU on their peak traces vs A100 for the same model binary with FP16 paths; L40S after quantization (4/8-bit) shows 1.7–2.0x effective tokens/sec per card but some quality delta on one or two heads (we flagged exact ops).
- Commercial levers: recommend 6% deeper reserved discount for a 12-mo commit if they accept hybrid pool with at least 60% L40S on steady capacity and 40% H100 for burst. This yields an effective blended $/1M-token in the XLS matching Camila's numbers.
- Suggest adding a 30-day performance verification window post-cutover to allow a quality/regression holdback clause (refund/credit if regression persists).

I can produce a short ops appendix for the runbook (cache warmup, canary traffic split config, rollback script pointers).

-Priyom
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>

Subject: Amendment and next steps — ready for signature + cutover schedule

Olivia / Procurement team —

Thanks — we've incorporated the feedback and attached the finalized amendment draft (amendment_draft.docx) with:
- Line items for +120 GPUs (60 new L40S, 60 new H100), regrade of 60 A100 → 30 H100 + 30 L40S as optional toggle,
- 12-month reserved pricing with the deeper discount when hybrid configuration accepted,
- SLO clause language (99.5% availability) with credit calculation,
- 30-day verification window and rollback acceptance criteria.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.example/FINX-DEAL-3721-amendment (expires 2027-05-01)
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/deal/FINX-DEAL-3721

Requested next steps from FintechX:
1) Confirm amendment redline acceptance or provide legal markups by 2027-04-19.
2) If accepted, sign via DocuSign and we'll schedule the migration in the 72-hour window the week of 2027-05-03.
3) Provide a point-of-contact for day-of cutover (ops pager).

If you want, Ben can run a quick executive summary call with your CFO to lock the economics.

Camila Reyes
